title: Checkout 503s after orders-cache failover
summary: orders-api returned 503 for 6% of checkouts; ERR_CACHE_TIMEOUT and READONLY replica errors followed an ElastiCache failover.
root_cause: The client kept pooled connections to the demoted primary after an orders-cache failover, and writes failed until connections were recycled.
resolution: Restarted orders-api with a rolling deployment; clients reconnected through the primary endpoint and errors cleared in 4 minutes.

title: Flash sale overloaded the session cache
summary: ERR_CACHE_TIMEOUT spiked during a flash sale with orders-cache engine CPU at 97%; no failover occurred.
root_cause: A single hot promotion key saturated the primary node during peak traffic.
resolution: Scaled orders-cache one node size up and set orders.cache.read_through=false until traffic fell.

title: Orders failing at inventory reservation
summary: ERR_INVENTORY_UNAVAILABLE on 11% of orders; the inventory-client circuit breaker opened after an inventory-service deploy.
root_cause: An inventory-service deploy exhausted its database connections and returned 503s.
resolution: Enabled orders.inventory.soft_reservation and the inventory team rolled back their deploy.
